scope: Corollary 7.3 of the manuscript “Approximation Paving over Arbitrary Maximal Abelian Subalgebras” (preprints/Approximation-Paving-over-Arbitrary-Maximal-Abelian-Subalgebras-September-25-2026/Approximation-Paving-over-Arbitrary-Maximal-Abelian-Subalgebras-September-25-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 300 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 2207c8250f6c6416), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 43. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Under the hypotheses of Lemma 7.2, let P act normally on a Hilbert space and let x = x∗ ∈ P satisfy ∥x∥ ≤ 1. For each m ≥ 2, the operators sxs supplied by that lemma approximate x strongly, with associated m-partitions P satisfying ∥sxs∥ ≤ 1, ∥CP(sxs)∥ ≤ 1/m. Here the approximation is on any prescribed finite set of vectors, to any positive accuracy, while m stays fixed.
